findings.description: C/C++ cryptographic API or configuration reference; effective primitive and runtime use require verification.
findings.migration_hint: Verify the primitive, purpose, linked provider and build configuration. A source request or provider/group setting does not establish runtime capability or negotiation.

recommended_actions.title: Introduce crypto abstraction boundary for algorithm agility
recommended_actions.rationale: Direct algorithm calls create high migration cost. A boundary layer enables staged classical-to-PQC transitions.
steps: Wrap signing, verification, keygen, and key exchange behind stable interfaces.
Add policy controls to select classical, hybrid, or PQC paths at runtime.

findings.description: OpenSSL low-level RSA API usage detected.
findings.migration_hint: Prefer high-level OpenSSL EVP APIs to ease PQC migration.

recommended_actions.title: Adopt a phased hybrid PQC migration plan
recommended_actions.rationale: The detected primitive is vulnerable to cryptographically relevant quantum attacks. Hybrid rollout minimizes compatibility risk.
steps: Inventory all call sites using this algorithm and owner teams.
Check for an existing classical + PQC composition; if migration is needed, evaluate compatible staged or hybrid modes before hard cut-over.
Define retirement dates for legacy classical algorithms.
